manifest.name: dsh-highlight-link
manifest.description: Repaints links and @-reference chips in the Harness Web UI and gives links a permanent underline, so they are easier to spot in long answers.

bundle.text:
# dsh-highlight-link bundle patch: registers the link-highlight plugin entry.
# The row id matches the package name so the store/manager can map the row back
# to this package by id. Keep the `id:` line free of trailing comments — the
# submission preflight reads it with a line regex.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-highlight-link
      name: dsh-highlight-link

readme.text:
让 DSH Web UI 里的链接和 `@` 引用更醒目：统一成一种颜色 `#7b97d9`，链接常驻下划线。
Makes links and `@`-references stand out in the DSH Web UI: one color (`#7b97d9`) plus a permanent underline on links.

[中文](#中文) · [English](#english)

---

插件在激活时注入**一张样式表**，卸载时移除。只改两处：

| 目标 | 宿主默认 | 装了本插件后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 正文链接、文件链接、来源链接、抓取到的 URL | `var(--dsw-alias-link)`（蓝），无下划线 | `#7b97d9`，实线下划线 |
| `@` 引用标签（`@文件`、`@会话`、`@技能`） | `var(--dsw-alias-state-business-primary)` | `#7b97d9` |

两处**故意分开设置**，原因是它们根本不是同一个东西：

- **链接**走语义 token `--dsw-alias-link`。改这个 token，所有消费它的组件自动跟着变，不需要逐个组件去点名。
- **`@` 引用标签不是链接的消费者**。宿主用 `--dsw-alias-state-business-primary` 给它们上色，而这个 token 同时被焦点环、`info` 色 tag 等共用。所以插件选择直接选中 `[data-ref-chip]`（稳定的业务属性），而不是去覆盖那个公共 token——否则会顺带把焦点环和标签也染成同一个颜色。

插件不碰渲染层以外的任何东西：不发网络请求、没有宿主侧行为、不读写会话数据。

- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`（写在 `engines.dsh` 里）
- 一个跑 Web UI 的 profile（`web`）

从 npm：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-highlight-link
```

从本地目录：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-highlight-link
```

装完重启 dsh，或让插件管理器直接应用。卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-highlight-link
```

也可以在「插件 → 发现」里搜 `highlight` 或 `link`，点一下安装。

颜色集中在一个常量里，改 `client.js` 即可：

```js
const LINK = '#7b97d9';
```

- 样式选择器用 `[data-ref-chip]` 这个业务属性，**不用**哈希类名 `_refChip_<hash>`——后者每次上游构建都会变。
- `!important` 是**刻意保留**的：皮肤类插件会把同一个 token 写成 `<body>` 上的普通内联声明，普通样式表规则压不过内联声明。
- 浅色主题下 `#7b97d9` 对默认浅色底约为 **2.7:1**，是刻意选的柔和色；深色底上约为 **6.3:1**。如果你更看重浅色下的对比度，把浅色那一档调深即可（同色相 `#4a68b8` 约 4.9:1）。

---

A small DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that makes links easier to spot in the Web UI:
links and `@`-reference chips get one shared color, and links get a permanent
underline instead of the hover-only dotted one.

The plugin injects a single stylesheet at activation and removes it when it is
unloaded. It changes two things:

| Target | Host default | With this plugin |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Markdown body links, file links, source links, fetched URLs | `var(--dsw-alias-link)` (blue), no underline | `#7b97d9`, solid underline |
| `@`-reference chips (`@file`, `@session`, `@skill`) | `var(--dsw-alias-state-business-primary)` | `#7b97d9` |

The two targets are set separately on purpose:

- Links follow the semantic token `--dsw-alias-link`, so every consumer of that
  token follows without targeting individual components.
- `@` chips are **not** link consumers — the host paints them with
  `--dsw-alias-state-business-primary`, which is also used by focus rings and
  info tags. The plugin therefore targets `[data-ref-chip]` (a stable business
  attribute) instead of overriding that shared token.

It also does not touch anything outside the renderer: no network requests, no
host-side behavior, no session data.

- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.1-rc.2` (declared as `engines.dsh`)
- A profile that runs the Web UI (`web`)

From npm:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-highlight-link
```

From a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-highlight-link
```

Then restart dsh, or let the plugin manager apply the bundle. To remove it:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-highlight-link
```

You can also find it in **Plugins → Discover** by searching `highlight` or `link`.

Edit `client.js`; the color lives in one constant:

```js
const LINK = '#7b97d9';
```

- The stylesheet targets `[data-ref-chip]`, a business attribute, not the
  hashed `_refChip_<hash>` class name (which changes on every upstream build).
- `!important` is used deliberately: a skin plugin may write the same token as
  a normal inline declaration on `<body>`, which would otherwise win.
- The light-theme value `#7b97d9` measures about 2.7:1 against the default light
  surface, so it is intentionally a soft color; on the dark surface it measures
  about 6.3:1. Darken the light value if you need higher contrast there
  (`#4a68b8`, same hue, is about 4.9:1).
